name: record_interpretation
arguments: {"test_id": "T1", "per_hypothesis": [{"id": "H1", "verdict": "unchanged", "why": "T1 is a stability (folding free energy) test. It does not measure WIP contacts, so it does not bear on the WASP/WIP interface claim. The FoldX value of +3.56 kcal/mol says nothing about binding. H1 still rests on E15, E4, E5, E8 and E9, none of which measured an interface contact at residue 45."}, {"id": "H2", "verdict": "supported", "why": "FoldX ddG for T45M is +3.56 kcal/mol on AF-P42768-F1, above the 2.0 kcal/mol destabilising threshold, with residue pLDDT 96.62 (T1). H2's refutation criterion was a solvent-exposed site with a predicted change under 1 kcal/mol. The measured value is 3.56, so that criterion is not met. The control T45R gave +7.43 kcal/mol, which fits a larger penalty for a bigger substitution at the same site. This adds direct stability evidence to E7, E9, E10, E13, E18, E11 and E3."}, {"id": "H3", "verdict": "weakened", "why": "H3 says the substitution changes shape 'without destabilising it'. T1 measured a destabilising ddG of +3.56 kcal/mol, which goes against that clause. H3's refutation criterion concerns GBD/CRIB contact distances, which T1 did not measure, so H3 is weakened and not refuted. Missense3d returned 'Neutral' (T1), but that is a weak, separate signal and does not offset the FoldX value."}], "uncertainty": "FoldX on a predicted model has errors near 1 kcal/mol, so +3.56 is a clear signal but not a precise magnitude. The result is a single predictor with no repeat or relaxation step, and the FoldX job returned no ID or manifest, so it is not independently reproducible from the record beyond the stored T1 values. Controls passed: pLDDT 96.62 at residue 45 (applicable), and the within-site comparison T45R +7.43 shows the predictor scales with substitution severity. A stability value alone cannot separate H2 from an interface effect, so H1 remains untested. The test does not measure the fold itself, so it cannot confirm a shape change (H3) or a lower folded fraction in cells. Validation still needed: relaxed or repeated FoldX, relative accessibility and neighbour packing at residue 45, and an experimental stability or expression measurement for T45M.\""}

name: record_decision
arguments: {"favoured_after": "H2", "why": "Previous favourite was H1 (WIP-interface disruption). T1 (FoldX ddG +3.56 kcal/mol, pLDDT 96.62; E7, E9, E10, E13, E18) gives H2 (core destabilisation) its first direct measured support and does not meet H2's refutation criterion (a change under 1 kcal/mol). H1 gained nothing, because T1 does not measure WIP contacts and H1's support stays at E15, E4, E5, E8 and E9. H3 was weakened because its 'without destabilising' clause conflicts with the measured value. H2 now has the strongest direct support, so the favourite changes from H1 to H2. The change is provisional: the stability value is a single predictor with about 1 kcal/mol error, and the interface hypothesis has not been tested yet."}
